tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per Tender Document.
The Contract is for 1 year and the bidder have to quote service charge per Month.
Negative Value of service charge is not allowed

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory completed, in at least one financial year in last five years 2020-21 to 2025-26, one similar contract of Providing manpower Services of value not less than Rs. 120.00 lakhs. Attach Experience Certificate issued by the Employer of State Government/ Central Government /State or Central undertaking boards / Urban local bodies.

Satisfactory completed, in at least one financial year in last five years 2020-21 to 2025-26, Providing Services of manpower in said services .Attach Experience Certificate issued by the Employer of State Government / Central Government /State or Central undertaking boards / Urban local bodies . The marks details are as in Tender document.

Service provider should have minimum 3 years experience in the field of providing man power services. Service provider needs to submit the Individual/firm/Company registration certificates by the competent authority.
Karnataka labour department Registration Certificate. Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities.
GST/Service Tax Registration Certificate. Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities.

Achieved in at least two financial years in last five years 2020-21 to 2025-26 annual financial turnover of Rs. 120.00 lakhs . Attach Certified balance sheet issued by Chartered accountant, With profit loss statement

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Accurate Postal Address and Contact no.
Affidavit of self declaration for Firm Non Blacklisted-Rs. 100 Stamp paper.
Agency should have a service Tax Registration Provident Fund Registration Employee State Insurance Registration and Professional Tax Registration.
Applicant agency should be working at any district of Karnataka water supply and sanitation area- Please attach work order or Work done certificates.
Audit Report for Profit and Loss A/C and Balance Sheet for the Last Five Financial Years.
Details of providing man power to Government offices-Present status
ESI Returns and Challans-Last three years challans to be enclosed.
